about_the_game:
The game is currently in development. This version represents an early stage of development, and some features and systems are still being refined.

Dopdop Online is a free-to-play collectible card game set in a surreal cosmic universe. Inspired by absurd sci-fi aesthetics, the game focuses on fast, tactical battles built around constant player choice — with absolutely no pay-to-win mechanics.

Key Features

Dynamic Deck Building (25–35 Cards)

Players can freely choose their deck size, ranging from 25 to 35 cards.
Smaller decks provide consistency, while larger decks offer flexibility and long-term planning.

Scrap System — Cards as a Resource

Any card in your hand can be Scrapped and converted into a resource.
Even an unplayable card always has value, allowing you to adapt, manage your economy, and recover from difficult situations.

Always a Meaningful Hand

At the end of each round, your hand is automatically refilled up to 5 cards.
This ensures that every turn offers multiple tactical options and encourages creative combinations instead of empty turns.

Four Core Heroes

Each hero belongs to a specific race and is defined by a unique glowing core color.
Your chosen hero influences deck synergies and how your Scrap economy functions.

Short, Fast-Paced Matches

Matches typically last 3–5 minutes, making the game ideal for quick sessions while retaining strategic depth.

Cosmic Arena

The current build features a single space-themed arena.
Additional arenas and visual improvements are planned for future updates.

Gameplay

Turn-Based 1v1 Matches

The main game mode uses automatic online matchmaking to search for a suitable opponent.
If no live opponent is available, the match may start against an AI-controlled opponent.

Tactical Depth Through Choice

Flexible deck sizes, the Scrap system, and consistent card draw ensure that every decision matters.
Victory comes from timing, synergy, and smart resource management — not luck alone.

Helpful Tutorial

An in-game tutorial introduces core mechanics, card interactions, and the Scrap system, helping new players get comfortable quickly.

Progression & Monetization

Free-to-Play

The game is completely free to play, with no paywalls and no pay-to-win mechanics.

Card Collection

Cards and packs can be earned through gameplay.
Optional purchases are designed to support progression without providing unfair advantages.

Live Systems in Development

Additional progression systems, events, and rewards are planned and will expand over time as development continues.

Platforms & Development

Current Availability

The game is currently available on PC.
Additional platforms and cross-platform features are planned for future development.

Ongoing Development

We are actively refining balance, expanding content, and improving systems based on development goals and player feedback.

Ready to Play?

Jump into Dopdop Online and experience fast, flexible card battles where every card matters — whether you play it, Scrap it, or save it for the perfect moment.
The cosmic journey has just begun.
